subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Week 4: final /x/ (fox, box, fix, six); sound differentiation

show.line: Listen to the end. Fox, box, six! They end with x.

rounds.prompt: Which one ends with x, as in fox?
Listen. s, i, x. What word is it?
Does it end with x? Sort the pictures.

hints: x at the end sounds like k and s together.
Listen to the very last sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that ends with x.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Bus ends with s. Box ends with x.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Box. It ends with x!

parent_line: Can hear and read x at the end of words like fox, box and six.
